$comment: [X2.7] Microsoft Learn MCP attach spec. Tier-1 first-party-ms (publisher microsoftdocs). FIRST http-sse transport — remote endpoint, NO command/args. Shape === mcp-specs/_template.json (X2.1). CC0-1.0.
title: Microsoft Learn Documentation
description: Authoritative Microsoft Learn documentation retrieval via the hosted Microsoft Learn MCP endpoint.

auth.recipe: no credentials required; the hosted endpoint serves public Microsoft Learn content.

sample_tools.name: microsoft_docs_search
sample_tools.summary: Search Microsoft Learn documentation for a query.

sample_tools.name: microsoft_docs_fetch
sample_tools.summary: Fetch the full content of a Microsoft Learn doc page.

known_limitations: Hosted remote endpoint — requires outbound network access to learn.microsoft.com; no local subprocess.
Read-only documentation retrieval; cannot modify any resource.
No package version to pin — `version_pin.package` is null and `version_range` is `hosted`; drift is tracked via the snapshot tools-list rather than a semver range.
Destructive-action audit (X2.18): no destructive tools — documentation retrieval is read-only.

client_install.claude_desktop: Add to claude_desktop_config.json mcpServers as `ms-learn` with the SSE endpoint `https://learn.microsoft.com/api/mcp`.
client_install.cursor: Settings → MCP → Add: name `ms-learn`, type SSE, URL `https://learn.microsoft.com/api/mcp`.
client_install.vscode: Add to .vscode/mcp.json servers as `ms-learn` with type `sse` and url `https://learn.microsoft.com/api/mcp` (VS Code Insider, MCP preview).
